title: Define Significance and Materiality Thresholds
detail: The SOP relies on 'judgement' to determine if a deviation is significant (Step 1, Section 5.2) or material for escalation (Step 3, Section 5.2). This lacks the precision required for consistent auditing and reporting.
proposed_text: Define significance as any variance greater than 10% from the target or prior year figure; define material deviations requiring escalation as those impacting regulatory compliance, public commitments, or exceeding a 20% variance threshold.
original_text: Use judgement to determine significance. ... The ESG team will use judgement to determine when escalation is required.

title: Establish a Centralized Deviation Log
detail: Section 5.2 Step 4 mentions documenting the deviation but does not specify where. For auditability, a centralized log is necessary to track all identified deviations, their causes, and the status of corrective actions.
proposed_text: Record all identified deviations in a Centralized ESG Deviation Log, capturing the metric ID, date of identification, variance percentage, root cause category, assigned owner for corrective action, and current resolution status.
original_text: Document the deviation, root cause, and corrective action. Include in the next ESG report.

title: Specify Escalation Path
detail: Section 5.2 Step 3 uses vague language ('appropriate level of management') which creates ambiguity regarding who is ultimately responsible for deciding on corrective actions for material issues.
proposed_text: Escalate material deviations to the CFO and the Sustainability Committee for review and decision on corrective actions.
original_text: If the deviation is material, escalate to the appropriate level of management.

title: Add Verification Step for Consolidated Data
detail: Section 4.2 describes consolidation but lacks a verification or 'four-eyes' check before the data is used for reporting or deviation analysis.
proposed_text: After consolidation, a second member of the ESG team or the ESG Head must perform a spot-check verification of the consolidated data against the source submissions to ensure transcription accuracy.
original_text: The ESG team will consolidate the data into the ESG reporting template

title: Align Deviation Definition with Document Terminology
detail: The terminology section defines deviation relative to the 'prior year figure', but Section 5.2 Step 1 refers to the 'prior period'.
proposed_text: Identify any metrics that are significantly different from the target or the prior year figure, in accordance with the document definitions.
original_text: identify any metrics that are significantly different from the target or prior period.
